description: This PHP class defines a custom widget button for the SuiteCRM user interface, specifically for creating a marketing email campaign from a subpanel. It extends the base button class and generates an HTML link with an onclick event to redirect to a campaign wizard page, using parameters derived from the layout definition.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignMarketingEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a button/link in the subpanel to initiate creating a marketing email campaign from a focus record.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates an HTML anchor tag that, when clicked, redirects the browser to the campaign wizard page with the appropriate parameters based on the focus record.
